stations.name: The Upskilling Labs, Inc.
stations.note: Holds the brand, the board, the Ambassador program and the national site

stations.name: National OLOS
stations.note: Gives every region the same platform; takes back what they prove

stations.name: The Upskilling Labs of Greater Washington
stations.note: Its own fork, site and database: a place to change things without touching national

stations.name: The steering committee
stations.note: Decides what the region becomes; ends in January

stations.name: Pod maintainers
stations.note: Review every pull request so the region stays compatible with national

stations.name: Builders in residence
stations.note: Three to five per pod; each turns a frame into one change

stations.name: Three research pods
stations.note: Scaffolding, Wayfinding, Front Door: each turns a problem into a paradox and frames

stations.name: Projects
stations.note: One change The Labs runs on, built on the region’s OLOS, used by a real person

stations.name: The showcase
stations.note: What held up is offered upstream to national OLOS, as pull requests

stations.name: Employers
stations.note: Not asked yet. What they could read: a record of what you built
